description.en: Loads an extra motion file onto a character so it can play motions from it, e.g. data/chr/motion/rpg/mot_uz_game01.xc (match moves). The third argument (default 2) and the optional fourth (a string) are passed to the loader; the events pass 2 or nothing. Remove extra motions with CMND_DELETE_MOTION.
Motion file (an archive path "file.pck|name.xc" also works).
Optional name passed to the loader.

The loader's result (true once queued).
false if the object is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Match moves for a scene (real usage, from ev42011800.nut)
